datePolicy: All external body URLs have explicit access evidence dated 2026-11-05 in the original source ledger. No fresh external localization research. Published 2026 and 2026/27 rates are not 2027-09 quotes. Year-assigned annual institutional milestones are labelled planning interpretations where applicable.
uncertainties: Personal GPA, degree equivalency, quantitative preparation, English evidence, research fit, admission and actual funding offers are unknown.

Brock duration differs between Goodman (two years/five terms) and the central programme page (20 months/five terms). The conditional CAD 67,615 family model requires the confirmed fellowship and shorter duration; assistantship earnings are not guaranteed permit cash.
UNBC prerequisites, thesis extensions and ongoing full international semester charges can increase cost. Its 2026-12-15 target for 2027-09 is inferred from an annual calendar, to reconfirm.
Douglas Finance campus/timetable is unconfirmed; optional supply-chain co-op is excluded. Exact CIP eligibility is a dated snapshot, not a future guarantee.
Coast Mountain 2027-09 intake/campus are unverified; annual fees are not total programme fees; its Business PDD is not PGWP eligible in the inspected evidence.

Living costs and most one-offs are author allowances, not live rental, clinic, test or airfare quotations. Later tuition, future funds indexation, PAL allocations and PGWP rules need rechecking; excluded costs require a separate budget.
editingContract: Readable corresponding English and Simplified Chinese lines, paragraphs and table cells retain matching complete numeric, currency, date and external URL occurrences against the pre-voice backup, normalizing Chinese date presentation. Named headline figures are semantic facts. Reader-facing internal links are replaced by data-driven provenance. Local draft only; no stars or review markup.

voiceRevisionNotes: Reader-first bilingual rewrite only; no external refresh, contacts, applications, payments, bookings or publishing. Technical run provenance remains in provenance and sourceListLink; original sources, access dates, headline figures and source artifact hashes are unchanged.
